newsitem.title: USA: PanAmSat makes satellite pact with BT.
newsitem.headline: PanAmSat makes satellite pact with BT.

text.p: PanAmSat Corp said Wednesday that British Telecommunications Plc's division of broadcast services plans to use more than 5,000 hours of capacity on PanAmSat's global satellite system on an as-needed basis through 1999.

"PanAmSat is providing BT Broadcast Services with the flexibility to access capacity on PanAmSat satellites at virtually any time, anywhere in the world," said Michael Antonovich, PanAmSat's vice president and general manager of broadcast services.
PanAmSat, which offers global satellite-based video and data communications services, did not disclose financial details of the pact.
